# ESPSomfy-RTS Gateways

Control commissioned Somfy RTS shades and existing groups through an installed ESPSomfy-RTS gateway using Muse Home Link, via its local HTTP API for supported movement and positioning. RTS is one-way radio, so reported positions are timed estimates, not motor feedback. No motor pairing/programming, no rolling-code manipulation, no flashing and no new gateway deployment.
